## Adzom microfiche reproduction

[CiNii BC01789043](https://ci.nii.ac.jp/ncid/BC01789043) describes an IASWR New York microfiche reproduction of **Sanje Dorje, New Delhi1977** Adzom print, **volume1 only in the listed holding**. Header **LMpj014,145**, target **SB2922**, National Museum of Ethnology holding **K03/2575/343 C982000772**. This corroborates publication provenance but does **not** establish a microfiche of volume2, where this root is printed. Classify as reproduction/collection-access lead; not another confirmed root witness. Raw catalogue page and hash saved here.

## Aleš Rýznar diplomatic edition and translation

The author's [7 February2022 research report](https://acef.university/ales-ryznar-interim-report/) reports completion and submission in November2021 of **The Necklace of Precious Pearls: An Analysis, Translation and Diplomatic Edition of the Dzogchen Tantra**, with review of **five textual witnesses**, a translation, a facsimile, and a Tibetan-English technical glossary. He was awaiting the defense date when reporting. This is a substantial **modern scholarly edition lead**; its five witnesses are not named in the report. It must not be counted as five newly identified physical witnesses.

An earlier [Charles University profile, compiled21 November2015](https://ujca-old.ff.cuni.cz/UJCA-373-version1.pdf) describes the project under an earlier title and expressly includes the Vimalamitra commentary. Indexed text was readable via web search; a direct PDF request now returned HTTP401. Searches for exact English titles, author with diacritics and ASCII spelling, Czech title variants, and the Charles University repository did not locate a public deposited full text. The DSpace search URL returned inaccessible via the web tool. **Submission is documented; successful defense/publication or public download is not established.** No contacts or messages sent.

## Nepal catalogue blocker and remaining coverage

The NGMCP catalogue **https://catalogue.ngmcp.uni-hamburg.de/wiki/Main_Page** returned a303 redirect to the university's **abuse-deny** page using normal curl. The web tool could not open the page/search, and Python also reported a certificate-chain error. No circumvention attempted. Thus the precise Nubri/Kathmandu root folios remain unresolved; their collection and microfilm identifiers are preserved in batch2.

Searches with exact title + NGMPP, Kathmandu, Nubri and Mustang did not expose another verified physical-root record. Similar titles identified in unrelated Chöd lineages, Cakrasaṃvara commentaries and Kagyu advice are not counted. This negative search is bounded to publicly retrievable results, not an exhaustive inventory of libraries.
